tags.name: InventoryIntegrationService
tags.description: Report on-hand stock for the warehouses you hold, and see what Zentail currently believes.

get.summary:
ListInventory returns what Zentail currently believes about the SKUs
stocked in the caller's warehouses.
get.description:
Two uses. It scopes a sweep — report only these SKUs rather than your whole
catalog. And it lets a caller send only genuine differences, which on a
large catalog is the difference between a viable poll loop and a pointless
one.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description:
Optional: only SKUs whose Zentail-side quantity changed since this time.
Omit for a full listing.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Leave empty for the first page; pass next_cursor thereafter.

post.description:
Idempotent and order-insensitive: replaying a call changes nothing, and an
update whose observed_ts predates what Zentail already holds is discarded
and reported as stale rather than applied. A slow retry overtaking a newer
reading cannot roll the count backwards.

get.summary:
IntegrationStatus returns diagnostic checks for the caller's integration —
whether warehouses are bound to it, when stock was last reported, and
whether Zentail considers that reading stale.
get.description:
An inventory integration fails quietly: nothing errors when a poll loop
stops, the numbers simply age. This is how that surfaces.

warehouseUniqueId.description: The caller's own identifier for the warehouse, not Zentail's internal id.

quantity.description: What Zentail currently believes is on hand.

lastUpdatedTs.description: When that belief was last updated, by anyone.

quantity.description:
Absolute on-hand, not a delta. What is physically there right now,
excluding anything already picked for an order.

binLocation.description: Optional free-text bin or slot, passed through for operator reference.

stale.description:
True when the update was discarded because observed_ts predated the value
Zentail already held. Not an error: the newer reading stands. Treat as
success unless it is happening constantly, which means clock skew or a
second writer.

inventory_apiInventoryUpdateResult.description:
InventoryUpdateResult echoes the full key of the update it answers. SKU alone
is not enough — a batch may carry the same SKU for two warehouses.

nextCursor.description: Empty when the page is the last one.

updates.description:
Server-capped per call. Exceeding the cap fails the request with the limit
in the error rather than silently truncating.

observedTs.description:
When the caller observed these quantities — not when it sent them. Required:
without it Zentail cannot tell a stale retry from a fresh reading, and
ordering is the whole basis of the idempotency guarantee.

results.description:
One entry per update. Order is not guaranteed, which is why each result
echoes its full key.
